text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
A full lineup of the top three ranks for 
the New Year! It's a triple Hatsumode, 
yes!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Aaah, I forgot my coins for the offering~!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'll lend it to you, Spe-chan.

Starting this year, El Condor Pasa and the 
others are finally in the Senior Year. I 
chaperoned the close trio on their first 
shrine visit of the year.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, Trainer-san. What that person is 
holding is a "Hamaya" arrow, right?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, Elle-Elle has heard a 
story like this before!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Even if one arrow breaks easily, three 
arrows can snap the opponent instead!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The three arrows... That's the anecdote of 
the Mori clan. Though it seems you've 
misunderstood part of it.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
If it's three arrows... Wait, what does 
that mean?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
In other words, this is what it means! If 
the three of us unite our hearts as one, 
even Suzuka-senpai can be defeated!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I get it! It's tough on your own, but 
if the three of us race and power up 
together...!

For the time being, the person all three 
of them should aim for seems to be the 
same.
(Clang clang!)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"I hope I get to run with Suzuka-senpai! 
And I hope I can run in a way that makes 
her proud of me."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I swear it. To devote myself and train 
hard enough to surpass Suzuka-senpai.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"I want to beat Suzuka-senpai! Without 
collapsing this time!"

Three people, three different ways of 
speaking. Yet, their wish was one and the 
same.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Let's do our best together, desu!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Oooh!

—And after parting ways with Special Week 
and Grass Wonder...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Is Suzuka-senpai going to run in 
El's primary goal this year, the 
Takarazuka Kinen?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Is that so?! In that case, I must train 
bravely and valiantly until then!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Suzuka-senpai, Spe-chan, and Grass. They 
are all wonderful rivals, but—"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Whose routine do you think would be best 
to adopt for our New Year's training, YES?

"Adopting someone else's approach," huh? 
Certainly, each of the three has their own 
distinct merits.

Special Week's cheerfulness. Grass 
Wonder's wisdom. Silence Suzuka's 
enigmatic nature.
If we try to imitate it...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oho, Spe-chan-style training!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Then the first thing that comes to mind is 
THAT, yes!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan was born in Hokkaido, so she's 
great at farm work! Harvesting in the 
fields is wonderful exercise, yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Pull out the carrot, brush off the dirt, 
and then—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Nom, munch munch♪

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That is riiiight! Spe-chan always sneaks a 
taste, you know!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Delicious, one more! No matter how much I 
eat, not guilty! Because it's Spe-chan, 
yes!

El Condor Pasa devoured the carrots one 
after another. It looks like her energy 
has been fully restored.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh, I don't eat that much, you know~!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oho, Suzuka-senpai-style training!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, Suzuka-senpai said it 
before. "I want to see the scenery where 
no one else is."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
OK! El-chan will aim for that kind of 
place too, and run her heart out! I'm off 
now, ya hear!
(Whooosh...)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
An off-season beach. There's... nobody 
here, desu ne. So pretty... And...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'm so looooneely! El doesn't want any of 
this! Traaiineeeer!

"At a furious pace, El Condor Pasa set out 
and returned. Enduring loneliness, she had 
grown a size larger."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
G-Grass-style training...? Knowing her, 
that sounds... a bit much.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It's gonna be tough, but if you say so, 
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Today is... for studying how to run, 
yes... Grass never cuts corners in her 
studies or her running, yes...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No matter how boring it gets, if it's 
necessary, I'll keep a cool face. Ughhh, I 
wanna run. But...

"Patiently dedicating oneself to classroom 
study. Taking a page from Grass Wonder, 
she seemed to learn various ways of 
thinking."
